title: The professional hierarchy: risk, then investments, then options
summary: Options are not the engine of a portfolio's growth. Professionals use a hierarchy: risk is the foundation, the underlying investments are the engine of growth, and options are the fine-tuning that shapes payoff profiles.

steps.caption: Foundation: risk. Set the maximum loss first.
Engine: the underlying investments create the growth.
Fine-tuning: options shape the payoff profile of the core.
This order separates investors from gamblers, in the speaker's words.

takeaways: Risk is the foundation of the portfolio.
Options shape payoffs; they are not the growth engine.
caveats: The clip ends with a promotion for tools the speaker is building.
